newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Music 1997 net seen at 244.9 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Music 1997 net seen at 244.9 mln pesos.

text.p: Music Semiconductor Corp is expected to post a net income of 244.9 million pesos in 1997, president Steve Stas told an investors briefing on Thursday.
Stas said Music's revenues are expected to rise to 817.6 million pesos in 1997.
Earlier on Thursday, Music Semiconductor told the Philippine Stock Exchange its net income soared by 155 percent to 160.214 million pesos in 1996 from 62.752 million in 1995.
It also said revenues in 1996 reached 510.008 million pesos from 311.431 million in the previous year.
Stas said Music Semiconductor is investing $12 million this year for the acquisition of additional software and hardware equipment.
"We are going to invest more (this year) to improve our market share ...and enhance our competitive barrier," Stas said.
"We are also enhancing our services," he added.
Music Semiconductor is one of the country's largest exporters of semiconductor products.
